interpretation: conditional paired calendar-cluster bootstrap, not proof of model equivalence or practical gain

protocol.alpha_selection: lowest pooled out-of-fold MAE; ties within 1e-10 prefer larger alpha

bootstrap.difference_sign: candidate minus reference; negative favours candidate
bootstrap.scheme: paired calendar block cluster percentile bootstrap; event-weighted metrics; all calendar blocks including empty ones; partial edge blocks retained

protocol.cv_fit: expanding past; origin and actual label finish strictly before fold start; fold outcomes finish strictly before fold end
protocol.error_sign: prediction minus actual; negative is underprediction
protocol.feature_recipe: cyclic local fractional hour and weekday; log1p minutes since latest completed clear; log1p last 3 completed durations; log1p median last5, last30, all; mean, population std, linear q25 and q75 of last30
protocol.final_fit: all feature-eligible records with starts and actual finishes strictly before 2026-01-01; no validation refit
protocol.final_test_access: none; only v1 pretest duration-events used
protocol.history_availability: actual finish <= current recorded start; completion order, same source and territory
protocol.model: StandardScaler then linear QuantileRegressor(q=0.5, L1, highs); duration target in minutes
protocol.model_retention_rule: promote only if MAE below both medians, upper 95% paired MAE difference below zero against both for 7d and 14d blocks, and MAE below rolling median in at least 4 of 6 months; otherwise retain median_last_30_completed as conservative pilot reference
protocol.prediction_domain: clip prediction below zero only; no upper cap; no outcome trimming
protocol.sample: unchanged Kyiv vadimkin_official sample and identical 277 validation events from v1
protocol.scaler_fit: new StandardScaler fit only on each fold's fit rows
protocol.scope: retrospective duration of registered closed Kyiv alerts at their recorded start
protocol.validation_history_updates: completed validation events may enter later features; fitted scaler and coefficients remain fixed
protocol.validation_reuse_limitation: v1 validation errors already observed; v2 is exploratory; no feature/alpha revision after v2 validation scoring
